YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE

Firebase sync

Sign in with Google to sync Chronos across devices. Local data remains available offline.

Connect your Firebase workspace

Use your own Firebase project. Configuration is stored on this device; do not enter private server credentials.

Firebase not configured

First sync creates a downloadable local backup, then merges by record ID and update time. Media attachments and recordings remain in local IndexedDB and are not uploaded. Firebase project credentials and security rules must be configured by you in Firebase Console.

SETUP CHECKLIST

Before connecting

  1. Create a Firebase projectUse the Firebase Console project you control.
  2. Register a Web AppCopy its Firebase configuration JSON into the form.
  3. Enable Google AuthenticationConfigure authorized domains, including the HTTPS domain where Chronos is hosted.
  4. Create Cloud FirestoreStart in production mode and install the Firestore rules from the included FIREBASE_SETUP.md.
  5. Deploy over HTTPSGoogle sign-in and browser storage require a supported secure origin (localhost is suitable for local development).
Media policy: Chronos syncs note text and metadata through Firestore only. Photos, attachments, and recordings stay in this browser/device and do not sync to Firestore. Download media items individually if you need to move them to another device. Never use service-account keys or Admin SDK credentials in this HTML file. Rules must restrict every user's data to their own UID.
